name: sa-visualization
description: Interactive views of the architecture: the Architecture Command Center — a navigable 3D model of the documented architecture (a floor per layer, every C4 L2 container a block, use-case walkthroughs, the physical deployment view), Alia the navigator with her dossier, findings on the stage, the load simulation and photo mode, as one self-contained HTML file. Reads the architecture through sa-skills, which installs it as a dependency.
